LESSON: DATA SAFETY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies.
Topic 1.2: Data Safety
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Data Safety, part of Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies. in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How is data protected in an electronic device?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Data Safety together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner interprets and infer skills to categorise computer hardware.

• Digital literacy: A learner connects computers and its accessories using technology.

Values:
Peace: A learner displays tolerance when performing tasks using computer hardware.

4

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Mental Health: A learner relates well with others as they discuss the categories of computer hardware.

Link to other Learning Area:

A learner is able to relate the skills used to perform tasks using input, output and storage devices to all learning areas when using digital

technology to search for information, download and watch videos.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Computer and its accessories and Print and Braille text books.

• Digital devices with assistive technology.

• Electronic devices.
